record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: For an admissible subcategory D of Db(X) that admits Serre-invariant stability conditions, is the stability manifold of D connected?

evidence.quote: one my wonder whether such a manifold is connected

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth projective variety over $\mathbb{C}$ with bounded derived category of coherent sheaves $D^b(X)$. Recall that a full triangulated subcategory $\mathcal{D} \subset D^b(X)$ is called admissible if its inclusion functor admits both left and right adjoints; in this case $\mathcal{D}$ has a Serre functor $S_{\mathcal{D}}$. A Bridgeland stability condition $\sigma = (\mathcal{A}, Z)$ on $\mathcal{D}$ (consisting of the heart of a bounded t-structure $\mathcal{A}$ and a central charge $Z$ satisfying the usual Bridgeland axioms, including the support property) is called Serre-invariant if $S_{\mathcal{D}} \cdot \sigma = \sigma \cdot \widetilde{g}$ for some $\widetilde{g}$ in the universal cover of $\mathrm{GL}^+_2(\mathbb{R})$ acting on the space $\mathrm{Stab}(\mathcal{D})$ of stability conditions.

Assume that $\mathcal{D}$ admits at least one Serre-invariant Bridgeland stability condition. Is the stability manifold $\mathrm{Stab}(\mathcal{D})$ connected?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g., on Kuznetsov components of prime Fano threefolds, cubic threefolds, Gushel–Mukai threefolds, cubic fivefolds) has identified connected components of stability manifolds containing Serre-invariant stability conditions and proved uniqueness results up to the action of the universal cover of GL⁺₂(ℝ). However, no general proof that the full stability manifold of an admissible subcategory admitting Serre-invariant stability conditions is connected appears in the literature; the question remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Stability manifolds of Kuznetsov components of prime Fano threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Serre-invariant stability conditions form a contractible connected component of the stability manifold.
status_evidence.claim: Serre-invariant stability conditions are shown to lie in a single connected (contractible) component, but global connectedness of the stability manifold is not established.

status_evidence.title: Serre-invariant stability conditions and Ulrich bundles on cubic threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: All known Serre-invariant stability conditions lie in the same orbit of the universal cover of GL⁺₂(ℝ).
status_evidence.claim: Uniqueness up to GL⁺₂(ℝ)-action established in specific cases, supporting but not proving general connectedness.
